forWhat: Every answer the engine was not sure of, one at a time, with the child's own writing.
You say what the child wrote. The engine then marks it by the answer key.

layout.shows: How many answers are left, how many are spot checks, and where you are.
The child's writing on the left, whose page it is in the middle, and the question, the right answer and your buttons on the right.
One sentence saying why this answer waits for a person.
Each assessment with answers waiting, and [[Start checking]].
The next answer, the next paper, or the class results when all is done.

jobs.title: Check answers
steps: Open Check answers and press [[Start checking]].
If the engine read it right, press [[Yes, the child wrote …]].
If not, use [[No — the child wrote]], type what the child wrote and press [[Save]].
If the box is empty, press [[Nothing is written here]].
For an answer only a person can mark, press [[Right]], [[Wrong]] or [[Blank]].
The next answer opens by itself.

buttons.label: Yes, the child wrote …
buttons.does: Says the engine read the answer right. The engine marks it.
buttons.doesNot: The engine's own reading is kept beside yours, so the reader can be measured.

buttons.label: Right
buttons.does: For an answer only a person can mark, settles that one answer.
buttons.doesNot: It does not sign off the whole page.

note: Why answers come here is on [How it is worked out](/guide/worked-out#checking).
